lines.text: The LORD declares woe on the shepherds who scatter His flock, and He will attend to them for their evil.
The LORD Himself will gather the remnant of His flock from all the lands and return them to their pasture.
The LORD will raise up prophets over His flock, and no sheep will be afraid, dismayed or missing.
The LORD will raise up a righteous Branch for David, who will reign as King, called The LORD Our Strength.
People will no longer swear by the LORD who brought Israel out of Egypt, but by the One who led them from the north.
